findings.claim: DoorDash Q1 2026 beat; Q2 2026 GOV guidance $32.4B-$33.4B vs ~$31.8B analyst expectation; CFO said demand patterns good; analyst view cites demand durability across grocery and retail. Risk: ~$50M/quarter fuel reimbursement drag.
findings.source: Invezz, DoorDash stock jumps 11% after earnings beat and strong delivery demand

findings.claim: US online food delivery market estimated ~$34.88B in 2025; Ken Research projects $58.30B by 2031 (~8.9% CAGR); no single 2027-2028 consensus found.
findings.source: Ken Research, USA Online Food Delivery Market

supply_demand_durability.note: Searches 3-4 (shortage/oversupply, supply discipline) not run; no excerpts verbatim; as_of for Ken Research is approximate. A Q3 2026 8-K (sec.gov) summary had inconsistent figures, not used.
